get.summary:
ListFavoriteParkingLots lists the caller's favorite parking lots, newest
favorite first.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

get.summary:
ListMyParkingLots lists the caller's submissions, including lots awaiting
review or rejected.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

get.summary:
ListNearbyParkingLots returns approved parking lots near the caller's
location, sorted by distance. Lots with outdated reports are demoted.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description:
latitude is the caller's WGS-84 latitude used as the search anchor.
Required.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description:
longitude is the caller's WGS-84 longitude used as the search anchor.
Required.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

post.summary:
CreateParkingLot submits a new parking lot for review. The lot is only
visible to the submitter until a reviewer approves it.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CreateParkingLotRequest is the input to CreateParkingLot.

get.summary:
GetParkingLot returns one parking lot. Pending and rejected lots are only
visible to their submitter (and reviewers).

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to fetch. Required.

patch.summary:
UpdateParkingLot updates a parking lot owned by the caller. Only pending
or rejected lots can be edited; editing resubmits the lot for review.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to update. Required.

post.summary: FavoriteParkingLot adds an approved parking lot to the caller's favorites.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to favorite. Required.

post.summary:
ReportParkingLotOutdated reports that an approved parking lot's
information is outdated. Each user can report a lot once; reports demote
the lot in nearby listings and surface a warning to other users.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot being reported. Required.

post.summary: ReviewParkingLot approves or rejects a pending submission. Admin only.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to review. Required.

post.summary: UnfavoriteParkingLot removes a parking lot from the caller's favorites.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to unfavorite. Required.

next_page_token.description: Continuation token for the next page. Empty means "no more pages".

total_size.description:
Total number of items known at the time of the response. May be
approximate for very large collections.

v1PageInfo.description: PageInfo is returned alongside any paginated response.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

page_token.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

v1Pagination.description: Pagination is the canonical request envelope for list RPCs.

id.description: id is the stable identifier of the parking lot.

name.description: name is the display name of the parking lot.

address.description: address is the human-readable location description of the parking lot.

latitude.description: latitude is the WGS-84 latitude of the parking lot entrance.

longitude.description: longitude is the WGS-84 longitude of the parking lot entrance.

cover_image_url.description: cover_image_url points to the cover image of the parking lot.

price_image_urls.description: price_image_urls point to images showing the pricing and charging rules.

payment_qr_image_urls.description: payment_qr_image_urls point to payment QR code images accepted at the lot.

status.description: status is the current review state of the parking lot.

review_comment.description: review_comment explains a rejection; empty for approved and pending lots.

submitter_id.description: submitter_id is the user who uploaded this parking lot.

created_at.description: created_at is when the parking lot was created.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the parking lot was last updated.

outdated_report_count.description:
outdated_report_count is the number of users that reported this lot as
outdated.

flagged_outdated.description:
flagged_outdated is true when the lot has at least one outdated report;
the frontend shows a "verify before use" hint when set.

outdated_reported_by_me.description:
outdated_reported_by_me is true when the caller already reported this lot
as outdated.

favorited_by_me.description: favorited_by_me is true when the caller has favorited this lot.

distance_m.description:
distance_m is the distance from the caller's location; only set in nearby
list responses.

v1ParkingLot.description: ParkingLot is a parking lot that can be discovered, favorited, and reviewed.

name.description: name is the display name of the parking lot. Required.

address.description: address is the human-readable location description. Required.

latitude.description: latitude is the WGS-84 latitude of the parking lot entrance. Required.

longitude.description: longitude is the WGS-84 longitude of the parking lot entrance. Required.

cover_image_url.description: cover_image_url is an optional cover image.

price_image_urls.description:
price_image_urls point to images showing the pricing and charging rules.
At least one is required.

payment_qr_image_urls.description:
payment_qr_image_urls point to payment QR code images accepted at the lot.
At least one is required.

v1ParkingLotDraft.description:
ParkingLotDraft is the user-editable content of a parking lot, used when
creating or updating a submission.

v1ParkingLotStatus.description:
ParkingLotStatus is the review state of a parking lot.

 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED is the default value; it is never used for
a real parking lot.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_PENDING_REVIEW: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_PENDING_REVIEW means the lot was submitted and awaits
review.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_APPROVED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_APPROVED means the lot passed review and is publicly
visible.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_REJECTED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_REJECTED means the lot was rejected and is only visible
to its submitter.

v1PingResponse.description: PingResponse is the output of Ping.

parking_lot.description:
parking_lot is the updated lot; outdated_report_count and
flagged_outdated reflect the report.

v1ReportParkingLotOutdatedResponse.description:
ReportParkingLotOutdatedResponse is the output of
ReportParkingLotOutdated.

parking_lot.description: parking_lot is the lot with the updated review state.

v1ReviewParkingLotResponse.description: ReviewParkingLotResponse is the output of ReviewParkingLot.

v1UnfavoriteParkingLotResponse.description: UnfavoriteParkingLotResponse is the output of UnfavoriteParkingLot.

parking_lot.description: parking_lot is the updated lot, resubmitted for review.

v1UpdateParkingLotResponse.description: UpdateParkingLotResponse is the output of UpdateParkingLot.
